instructions:
## Objective

Accelerate Patterson-standardized population-genetics PCA from unindexed VCF files.

## Work to perform

Implement a command-line program with Python, NumPy and SciPy. Preserve mean imputation and HWE standardization across eligible markers. Commit the code; use public synthetic cohort generators and validators for development.

## Deliverable

pca <vcf> <k> <out.tsv> program.

## Evaluation

Accuracy-gated speedup across four fresh cohorts, with peak-memory penalties and probes for standardization and adequate marker coverage.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
